name: Jain no Ikenie ~Shokushu-hime Altea & Mashikyuu Tsukai Bianka Owari no Nai Jutai~
original_name: 邪淫のいけにえ ～触手姫アルテア＆魔子宮遣いビアンカ 終わりの無い受胎～
source:
[i]A collection of two Chaos-R games based in the same universe, bundled together for an international release: Tentacle Princess Altea and Saint Bianca's Ceaseless Conception![/i]

With her golden blond hair and sapphire blue eyes, Princess Altea is known across the land for her extraordinary beauty. However, to end the terrible drought that has ravaged her beloved Kingdom of Aquila, she is sacrificed to the sorcerer Aldebaran. Upon arrival to Aldebaran's mansion she meets Deneb Swan, another sacrificed princess. Together, they work together to escape the wicked sorcerer and regain their freedom.

In another land...
Bianca is a saint destined to give birth to the Child of God – the future savior of humanity who will defeat a looming demon threat! She is abducted by a demon lord and forced into becoming a pawn in their scheme to change the fate of the world by having the Child of God be sired by no man.

[From [url=https://jast.games/games/sweet-sacrifices]JAST[/url]]
translation:
[i]基于同一宇宙的两款Chaos-R游戏的集合，捆绑在一起进行国际发行：触手公主阿尔特亚和圣比安卡的无尽构想！[/i]

阿尔特亚公主拥有金色的金发和宝蓝色的眼睛，以其非凡的美丽而闻名全国。然而，为了结束蹂躏她心爱的天鹰王国的可怕干旱，她被献祭给巫师毕宿五。抵达阿尔德巴兰的宅邸后，她遇到了另一位被牺牲的公主德尼布·斯旺 (Deneb Swan)。他们齐心协力，逃离邪恶巫师的追捕，重获自由。

在另一片土地…
比安卡是一位圣人，注定要生下上帝之子——人类未来的救世主，他将击败迫在眉睫的恶魔威胁！她被恶魔领主绑架，并被迫成为他们计划中的棋子，该计划旨在通过让上帝的孩子不再由男人生育来改变世界的命运。

[来自[url=https://jast.games/games/sweet-sacrifices]JAST[/url]]
